t3_source: tekken-wiki TTT2 Jun Kazama movelist (documented, no teardown bank)
frame_convention: Startup in seconds @60fps. Damage = Tekken values, WH 100HP. Hit ranges from the TTT2 movelist; startup values from documented i-frames where known (i10 1,2,4 / i13 b+4,2 / i14 d/f+2,1 / i16 u/f+4,3 / i16 d/b+1,2), otherwise standard Tekken archetype estimates.
canon_note: Megami = the Shrine Soul (roster/parvati). Jun Kazama's Kazama Style Classic Martial Arts kit, rebuilt with Tekken inputs: a guardian's kit — parries, reversals (Attack Reversal), stance transitions (Genjitsu b+1+2, Izumo f+1+2), frame-perfect punishment. Canon-layered: Sealed Door (d/b+1+2), Threshold Keeper (b+1+2~b), Kaimon (GEN 1+2).
